title: Twinwright agent response (twinwright.agent.v1)
description: The one JSON object an agent writes to stdout. Twinwright refuses unknown fields, a missing or different protocol, and any data after the object. A response with an empty content and no tool calls is refused too.

content.description: Text for the turn. With no tool calls it is the agent's final answer and ends the run.

tool_calls.description: Calls the agent proposes. Use [] to end the run. Each call needs an id that is unique within the run, and an operation_id from the request's operations. The dispatcher decides whether the call is allowed.

usage.description: Optional token counts, recorded with the turn.
